title: One week at Zuri Atelier
headline: One week at *Zuri Atelier*
sub: Orders, fittings, money, staff and suppliers, all run alongside her chats.

reel.caption: Zainab signs up and sets up her business in minutes.

narration.en: Zainab signs up and sets up her business in minutes.
narration.pcm: Zainab sign up and set up her business for few minutes.

reel.caption: One dress, every size and colour, counted.

narration.en: One dress, every size and colour, each with its own count.
narration.pcm: One dress, every size and colour, each get im own count.

reel.caption: A WhatsApp order becomes an order card.

narration.en: When a customer orders on WhatsApp, Taskiem turns it into an order.
narration.pcm: When customer order for WhatsApp, Taskiem go turn am to order.

reel.caption: Money arrives and finds its invoice.

narration.en: When the money arrives, she matches it to the invoice in one tap.
narration.pcm: When the money enter, she go match am to the invoice with one tap.

reel.caption: A rider takes it, and she follows it.

narration.en: A rider takes the order, and she follows it to the door.
narration.pcm: Rider go carry the order, and she go follow am reach door.

reel.caption: Tasks for her team, done on their phones.

narration.en: She gives Dami a task, and Dami marks it done.
narration.pcm: She give Dami task, and Dami go mark am done.

reel.caption: Low on fabric? Reorder in a few taps.

narration.en: When fabric runs low, she reorders from her supplier in a few taps.
narration.pcm: When fabric dey finish, she go reorder from her supplier with few taps.

reel.caption: A deal, within the limits she sets.

narration.en: A business haggles for fifty uniforms. Staff deal within her limits, and she approves the rest.
narration.pcm: Business dey haggle for fifty uniform. Staff go deal inside her limits, and she go approve the rest.

narration.en: Every morning, her numbers are waiting: money in, orders, and what needs her.
narration.pcm: Every morning, her numbers dey wait: money wey enter, orders, and wetin need her.

reel.caption: Nothing goes out without her OK.

narration.en: And nothing goes out without her OK.
narration.pcm: And nothing go out without her OK.

bridge.en: It all starts with opening her shop.
bridge.pcm: Everything start with how she go open her shop.

flow.purpose: cold open: Monday morning, a full week ahead
flow.action: Turns the pages of a paper diary full of handwritten orders, lets out a small sigh, then picks up her phone with a determined smile
flow.setting: Zuri Atelier workroom, Surulere: a bright room, a cutting table with bolts of Ankara in indigo, gold and green, two sewing machines, a rack of finished outfits in plastic covers, a mirror with a fitting platform, a window on a yellow-painted wall
flow.camera: slow push-in, medium close-up, warm morning light

flow.purpose: closing: the week done, the doorway at dusk
flow.goes: closing, after the footage, before the call to action
flow.action: Stands in the workroom doorway at dusk, phone in hand, looks back at the busy room with quiet pride, then smiles and switches off the light
flow.setting: Zuri Atelier workroom at dusk, warm lamp light, the rack full of finished outfits
